title: The growth moment playbook
summary: Discover how to prepare fulfillment for the moments when rising demand, new channels and growing complexity put operations to the test.
body_markdown:
******Playbook******


# **How brands stay ahead when demand, complexity and expectations rise**


[Download this report](https://gxo.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/GXO-TheGrowthMomentPlaybook_Final-Copy.pdf)


## ******Introduction******


Growth can arrive through a viral spike, retail expansion, a larger assortment or rising delivery expectations. As these pressures converge, fulfillment becomes critical to helping brands adapt without losing control of the customer experience.


The Growth Moment Playbook explores how flexible order fulfillment helps brands navigate the pivotal moments that define whether they scale or stall.


### ****In this playbook, you’ll explore:****


- How to respond when sudden demand tests inventory, capacity and execution
- What retail expansion, faster delivery and new channels require from fulfillment
- How adaptable operations help protect customer experience as complexity grows


“Growth moments test more than volume. They test operational control, consistency and brand trust. Our role is to make sure fulfillment never becomes the constraint as brands scale.”


**Jamie Saucedo**
Senior Vice President, Business Operations, GXO Direct


## **********Key insights**********


### ****Viral demand tests operational agility****


Sudden attention can quickly push inventory, labor and throughput beyond the plan. The ability to respond in real time helps turn first-time purchases into lasting loyalty.


### ****Retail changes the operating model****


Routing guides, labeling, ASNs, delivery windows and store-ready execution introduce requirements that extend across warehouse operations, technology and inventory flow.


### ****Faster delivery starts with smarter design****


Inventory placement, network design, carrier mix and service levels must work together to improve delivery speed without creating unsustainable costs.


### ****Post-purchase fulfillment builds loyalty****


Order accuracy, branded packouts, personalization, unboxing and returns shape what customers remember and whether they purchase again


## **Prepare for what growth brings next**


The moments that create opportunity can also expose the limits of an operation. Learn how brands are building fulfillment models that respond to changing demand, support new channels and protect what customers expect as the business evolves.
